blocks.content: Course: CSS Fundamentals for Your First Webpage
What makes a good Skeleton for starting CSS?

items: Semantic HTML: Sections are built using elements like <header>, <main>, <section>, <article>, <footer> for clarity and accessibility.
Reusable Elements: Lists, tables, and forms are included so you can practice styling multiple elements consistently.
Scalable Layout: The page is structured so you can style incrementally, one section at a time, following a developer workflow.

blocks.content: Now that you understand what each section is and why it exists, we'll look at the actual output after CSS. You'll make it happen throughout the course, lesson by lesson, applying all the CSS concepts we'll learn.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
